# AdbLib cryptography

Source: https://github.com/cgutman/AdbLib at d6937951eb98557c76ee2081e383d50886ce109a. BSD 3-Clause; see LICENSE and UPSTREAM.json. Only AdbCrypto and AdbBase64 are compiled. Kinegra Home supplies its own bounded, loopback-only sequential transport. The public-key comment is changed to KinegraHome@localhost. Private keys are generated on the device and excluded from backup/source control.
